title: Make apps/web's ESLint gate able to fail on a warning-level rule via --max-warnings 0
objective: CI step 'ESLint (apps/web)' runs 'npm run lint', which was 'eslint .' with no --max-warnings. ESLint exits 0 when only warnings exist, so react-refresh/only-export-components (warn) and every future warn-level rule could not fail the build. This slice adds --max-warnings 0 to the lint script so the gate is load-bearing, fixing any warnings that surface (none did).
in_scope: Measuring before/after warning counts by rule.
Proving the gate is now load-bearing with a deliberate warn-level violation and exit-code contrast.
out_of_scope: Weakening any rule (no warn->off, no eslint-disable, no ignores, no non-zero allowance).
Any lockfile change or npm install/i/update/audit fix.
acceptance_criteria: Clean tree: npm run lint exits 0 with the new script.
With a deliberate react-refresh/only-export-components violation: OLD script exits 0 (the defect), NEW script exits non-zero and names the rule.
Both package-lock.json files byte-identical to origin/main baselines (98f786c2bb0d, 737f99159e58).
apps/web typecheck, test, build, format:check all pass locally.

gate_load_bearing_proof.probe: src/__probe_refresh.tsx exporting a non-component function alongside a component (removed after test)

hard_rules_acknowledged: Installed with npm ci only; never npm install/i/update/audit fix.
Both lockfiles byte-identical to baseline, verified via git hash-object.
agent-state/progress.md appended to only; current_contract.json replaced (single-slot).
